name: artifact-use
description: Agent-friendly artifact publishing on Cloudflare R2/D1 with WorkOS creator auth.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/client-core && npm run build -w packages/cli && npm run build -w packages/mcp-server && npm run build -w apps/worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/client-core && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.check: prettier --check . && diff -r skills/artifact-use plugins/codex/artifact-use/skills/artifact-use && npm run typecheck
